fr1.t: French Holidays & Seasons Bundle: Word Search, Crossword & Bingo (11 Themes)
fr1.md:
**Get 11 French vocabulary packs in one bundle and save 30%.** From Halloween, Christmas and la Chandeleur to Bastille Day, plus the four seasons. Each pack practises 20 essential words on one theme with no-prep printable activities: perfect for KS2, KS3 and KS4 French lessons.

**Themes included (11 packs, 27 pages each):**

- Halloween (Halloween)
- Christmas (Noël)
- New Year (Le Nouvel An)
- Epiphany (L'Épiphanie)
- Candlemas (La Chandeleur)
- Valentine's Day (La Saint-Valentin)
- Bastille Day (Le 14 Juillet)
- Autumn (L'automne)
- Winter (L'hiver)
- Spring (Le printemps)
- Summer (L'été)

**Every pack includes:**

- Vocabulary list (French with articles + English)
- Word search with French word bank, plus a translation word search
- Crossword with word bank and a challenge crossword (English clues, French answers)
- Bingo: 30 different printable cards, teacher checklist and calling cards
- Answer keys for every puzzle

Standard French with British English translations. Bilingual instructions (French + English). Every word search is computer-checked so each word appears exactly once.

**Great for:** starters, early finishers, cover lessons, stations, vocabulary review and homework.

**More bundles:** Basics & People (13 themes), Everyday Life (16 themes) are also in the Letra Amable shop at 30% off. Want to try the format first? Download the FREE French Numbers pack.
